book_title: Before You Read: Executive Thesis, Stop Breach & Dual Verdict
question: What changed at Arista Networks since November 13, why are we exiting held shares immediately, and why is new capital rejected?

epigraph.quote: In investing, what is comfortable is rarely profitable.
epigraph.author: Robert Arnott

web_blocks.html: Business Quality (COMPOUNDER_PASS, PASS_WITH_WATCH): Arista Networks (NYSE: ANET) makes high-speed data center switches and EOS software [1][9]. The firm holds $14.36 billion in cash and zero debt [2][22]. Return on invested capital sits at 28.89%, and total RPO reached $8.6 billion [2][22]. Nine-month 2026 sales grew 44.3% YoY to $9.40 billion with a 44.4% GAAP operating margin [2]. On November 17, Arista launched 5nm R4 switches for AI inferencing [28]. Still, new risks emerged. Nine-month GAAP gross margin fell 160 bps YoY to 62.9%, and FCF conversion slowed to 104.8% [2]. Evaluation inventory doubled to $874.3 million [2]. NVIDIA also revealed Meta is expanding Spectrum-X and BlueField-4 alongside NVLink Fusion for custom chips [30]. Commitments of $11.4 billion lack Broadcom supply guarantees, while buybacks stayed at $0 [1][2].

EXIT IMMEDIATELY — Holding Action (39.599149 shares, $6,637.61 value, 8.84% weight): Sell all 29.4043 Schwab shares ($4,928.75) and 10.194849 Robinhood shares ($1,708.86) right away. On November 20, ANET closed at $167.62 in facts ($167.66 on TradingView). That broke our locked $172.09 stop on 1.67x volume. Price fell under its 50-day ($192.01), 30-week ($177.78), and 200-day ($168.58) averages inside an S&P 500 Downtrend. Keep 100% of the $6,637.61 proceeds in USD cash. That rebuilds Schwab's $22.43 cash buffer and cuts 234.2% effective market exposure.

REJECTED — New Capital (REJECTED, TIER_0, VALUATION + TREND): Deducting 4.0% SBC (37.0% ex-SBC FCF margin) across 1.2782 billion diluted shares shows $167.66 embeds a 16.24% 10-year revenue CAGR [2][22]. We cut our 12-month Base target to $180.00 ($179.35 ex-SBC DCF), with Bear at $115.00 ($109.31 stressed) and Bull at $215.00, yielding a flat $167.50 expected value (-0.1%). Because ANET sits in STAGE_4 (CAP_REJECTED) and fails 1.50:1 R:R at CMP (0.36:1), at the $177.78 30W reclaim (0.05:1), and at Pivot S1 $153.61 vs. Pivot S2 $133.83 (1.33:1), new capital is REJECTED with 0.0% weight.

Four gates must clear before Arista merits a fresh review. First, shares must carve a Stage 1 base above $133.83 Pivot S2 and reclaim the 30-week SMA ($177.78) on >1.3x volume. Second, price or cash-flow revisions must restore >=1.50:1 R:R on a >=1.0x ATR ($12.68) stop against ex-SBC fair value. Third, February 2027 Q4 earnings must guide >=$18.0 billion FY2027 sales with >=62% GAAP gross margin. Fourth, Note 3 must show evaluation inventory ($874.3 million) and $11.4 billion commitments burning down without write-downs.

book_paragraphs: Arista Networks remains one of the highest-quality hardware-and-software franchises in artificial intelligence networking, compounding sales more than eightfold over the last decade while carrying $14.36 billion in debt-free cash and 44.4% nine-month GAAP operating margins. On November 17, 2026, management reinforced that engineering lead by unveiling 5-nanometer R4 Etherlink platforms tailored for distributed AI inferencing, backed by $8.6 billion in remaining performance obligations.

Yet disciplined investing separates admiring a business from paying too much into a downtrend. Since our November 13 review, nine-month footnotes exposed 160 basis points of gross margin compression to 62.9% and a doubling of evaluation inventory to $874.3 million, NVIDIA disclosed expanded Meta Spectrum-X and NVLink Fusion competition, and deducting 4.0% SBC across 1.2782 billion diluted shares lowered our Base fair value to $180.00. On November 20, Arista fell 11.57% to $167.66 ($167.62 in facts), shattering our locked $172.09 structural stop on heavy volume—forcing an immediate exit on all 39.599149 held shares into cash while new capital is Rejected on Valuation and Trend.
